tools.name: ifood_vendas_pedidos_listar
tools.description: Lista os pedidos da loja no iFood por período (agrupados por dia, com status, valores e id), via a API interna do Portal do Parceiro.

tools.name: ifood_vendas_pedido_detalhe
tools.description:
Detalhe de um pedido específico do iFood (status, datas, distância de entrega, id do parceiro).

Bulk support: accepts order_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: ifood_vendas_repasses
tools.description: Lista os lançamentos financeiros / repasses da loja no iFood (extrato financeiro do Portal do Parceiro).

tools.name: ifood_vendas_financeiro_resumo
tools.description: Resumo financeiro agregado do período (total de pedidos, faturamento, ticket médio, série diária), pronto para gráfico.

tools.name: ifood_vendas_loja
tools.description: Dados da conta/loja no Portal do Parceiro iFood (perfil, papéis e permissões).

tools.name: ifood_vendas_cardapio
tools.description: Retorna o catálogo/cardápio da loja no iFood (produtos, categorias e preços).

tools.name: ifood_vendas_disponibilidade
tools.description: Status de disponibilidade da loja no iFood (aberta/fechada, pausas e horários).

tools.name: show_version
tools.description: Show the current MCP platform and adapter versions.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug, missing feature, or send feedback. Include the conversation array with recent messages for reproduction.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Returns connection status and URLs. When all providers are connected, returns authenticated:true and empty pending[]. When credentials are missing, returns connect_url for the toolkit and per-install URLs.

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.

findings.detail: Tool "toolkit_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
